statement_committed: No new WWOX clinical report will state a worsening of seizures or of the course after or during a named antiseizure agent by the expiry.
definition_of_the_event: A report on one or more WWOX/WOREE patients containing a sentence that says seizures or the course got WORSE during or after a named antiseizure agent (not non-response; the extractor's definition), read in full or in the abstract.
pubmed_query_with_date_field: (WWOX[tiab] OR WOREE[tiab]) AND (seizure*[tiab] OR epilep*[tiab] OR spasm*[tiab]) AND (worsen*[tiab] OR exacerbat*[tiab] OR aggravat*[tiab] OR paradox*[tiab]) AND ("2026/11/17"[dp] : "2027/11/16"[dp]); plus every new WWOX/WOREE clinical report read for such a sentence
second_route_at_expiry: Europe PMC REST, same terms in TITLE_ABS and BODY, re-run on the expiry date; the daily outside-changes check for new WWOX papers
base_rate_basis: Held: 0 worsening statements in 206 extracted rows from 14 reports. Literature: clinical WWOX/WOREE report counts per year (Europe PMC, title/abstract): 6 (2023), 5 (2024), 7 (2025), 10 (2026 to 16 November); worsening-term hits in the same fields: 0, 1, 1, 0. Rule-of-three bound for 0 of 14 reports: at most about 21% per report; with 5 to 10 reports expected in the year the expected number of qualifying reports is at most about 1.5 and the central estimate under the held rate is below 0.5.
trivial_baseline: Poisson with the held-data upper bound: P(zero) about 22% at the bound, higher at the central rate; the trivial baseline is 'one or more appears at the bound rate'
rejecting_result: One qualifying report appears. Which class it names decides the consequence.
matrix_or_card_it_would_change: AH1 to AH4 (aggravation hypotheses): a report on a sodium-channel blocker supports AH1; on a GABA-A positive modulator or benzodiazepine supports AH3 and AH4; none changes the frozen matrix cells but each would be a first held statement for T12, T17
hindsight_check: No: the base rates are counts of held and public records, not a knowledge of any paper after 2026-11-16

statement_committed: No paper will report a drug-by-genotype contrast in any Wwox-deficient model by the expiry: a design in which Wwox-deficient AND wild-type animals or cells both receive the agent AND vehicle, with the interaction reported or testable from the printed values.
definition_of_the_event: A 2 x 2 (genotype x agent) design in a Wwox knockout, null, mutant or knock-in model, by any laboratory, with the genotype-by-agent term reported or computable from printed means and n.
pubmed_query_with_date_field: (Wwox[tiab] OR WWOX[tiab]) AND (knockout[tiab] OR null[tiab] OR mutant[tiab] OR deficient[tiab] OR deficiency[tiab]) AND (treat*[tiab] OR drug[tiab] OR inhibitor[tiab] OR vehicle[tiab] OR rescue[tiab]) AND (seizure*[tiab] OR neuron*[tiab] OR brain[tiab] OR epilep*[tiab]) AND ("2026/11/17"[dp] : "2027/11/16"[dp]); each hit read for the design
second_route_at_expiry: Europe PMC REST same terms re-run at expiry; the daily outside-changes check
base_rate_basis: Held: one paper with drug arms in a neuronal Wwox model (Cheng 2020: ethosuximide and lithium), without an interaction test, wild type near the floor (SCI NX1 and Fig 7 packages). Public counts (Europe PMC, title/abstract, neural terms): 0 (2023), 0 (2024), 1 (2025), 2 (2026 to 16 November); a rescue by gene therapy (knockout against knockout plus vector) is a different design and is not this event.
trivial_baseline: Baseline: the 2025-2026 rate (about 1.5 hits per year, most of them not 2 x 2 designs) gives about 0.5 qualifying papers in the year: P(zero) about 60%; trivial baseline 'one or more appears'
rejecting_result: A qualifying 2 x 2 paper appears in the window
matrix_or_card_it_would_change: The first drug-by-genotype cell for any class: its tier-3 drug-by-genotype score (score_drug_by_genotype) leaves zero for the first time

statement_committed: No laboratory outside the Aqeilan-Carlen network will publish a measurement of the GluN2B-sensitive (NAM-sensitive) share of the NMDAR current in Wwox-deficient neurons by the expiry.
definition_of_the_event: A measurement of the fraction of NMDAR current (or EPSC) removed by a GluN2B-selective antagonist in neurons or slices of a Wwox-deficient model, from a laboratory without a shared author list with Breton 2021, Repudi 2021, Steinberg or Obeid.
pubmed_query_with_date_field: (Wwox[tiab] OR WWOX[tiab]) AND (NMDA*[tiab] OR GluN2B[tiab] OR NR2B[tiab] OR ifenprodil[tiab] OR "Ro 25-6981"[tiab]) AND ("2026/11/17"[dp] : "2027/11/16"[dp]); author lists checked against the network
second_route_at_expiry: Europe PMC REST, TITLE_ABS and BODY, re-run at expiry; the daily outside-changes check
base_rate_basis: Public counts of Wwox plus NMDA-receptor terms in title or abstract: 0 (2023), 0 (2024), 0 (2025), 0 (2026 to 16 November); 1 hit over all years (a transcript-level mention in Aldaz 2019). The origin hunt found no measurement of it in any WWOX preparation.
trivial_baseline: Baseline: the all-years rate is about 0.06 per year: P(zero) about 94%, so this is a confirmation of an expectation, not a surprise
matrix_or_card_it_would_change: A second origin for the NMDAR thread T1/T11: the single-origin collapse of the matrix would stop applying to the NMDAR axis

statement_committed: No paper will report a Cav3 isoform-resolved measurement for efonidipine or flunarizine under a fully stated protocol by the expiry.
definition_of_the_event: A paper giving an IC50, Kd or percent block for efonidipine or flunarizine at two or more of Cav3.1, Cav3.2 and Cav3.3, with holding potential, charge carrier, stimulation frequency and temperature stated; any context (not necessarily WWOX).
pubmed_query_with_date_field: (efonidipine[tiab] OR flunarizine[tiab]) AND (Cav3*[tiab] OR "T-type"[tiab] OR CACNA1G[tiab] OR CACNA1H[tiab] OR CACNA1I[tiab]) AND ("2026/11/17"[dp] : "2027/11/16"[dp]); each hit read for the isoform data and the protocol
second_route_at_expiry: Europe PMC REST, same terms re-run at expiry; ChEMBL lookup of new activities for the two compounds on CACNA1G, H and I
base_rate_basis: Public counts of the two compounds with T-type terms in title or abstract: efonidipine 0 (2023), 1 (2024), 3 (2025), 1 (2026 to 16 November); flunarizine 1, 1, 1, 1; almost all are not isoform-resolved. Held (RP-016, ADV-009): isoform-resolved numbers exist for flunarizine only (Santi 2002, 2002 matched triple) and for efonidipine at one isoform (Perez-Reyes 2008) plus an abstract-level qualitative pattern (Furukawa 2009): two efonidipine papers in 17 years, about 0.1 per year.
trivial_baseline: Baseline about 0.1 per year for a qualifying efonidipine paper: P(zero) about 90%
matrix_or_card_it_would_change: RP-016 qualified proposal: the efonidipine and flunarizine pair would become a matched pair or be demoted; the Cav3 arm of the brief could name its representatives with a source

statement_committed: No paper will report the age dependence of an NMDAR measure (a subunit-sensitive fraction, a decay-time constant or a current) in a Wwox-deficient model by the expiry.
definition_of_the_event: A measurement of an NMDAR property at two or more postnatal ages in Wwox-deficient neurons or slices, by any laboratory.
pubmed_query_with_date_field: (Wwox[tiab] OR WWOX[tiab]) AND (NMDA*[tiab] OR GluN2*[tiab] OR NR2*[tiab]) AND (postnatal[tiab] OR age[tiab] OR development*[tiab] OR P7[tiab] OR P14[tiab]) AND ("2026/11/17"[dp] : "2027/11/16"[dp])
second_route_at_expiry: Europe PMC REST, TITLE_ABS and BODY, re-run at expiry; the daily outside-changes check
base_rate_basis: Same public counts as PR-07: zero in each of the last three years and one hit over all years, none with an age series. Held: the only age-dependent NMDAR quantity is WO-11 in wild-type barrel cortex (53% at P6-P8, 14% at P13-P15).
trivial_baseline: Baseline about 0.05 per year: P(zero) about 95%
matrix_or_card_it_would_change: The T11 thread (age-dependent GluN2B share) acquires a WWOX-system tier 3; the age windows of the matrix (P6-P8 against P13-P15) become scorable for the NMDAR classes
